project_name.justification: The authoritative project name is 'Blue Grouse Mine Claims'. The text confirms the project involves claims at the location of the former Blue Grouse Mine: 'The Claims comprise the area formerly known as the Blue Grouse Mine ("Blue Grouse")...'

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified in the first sentence: 'SASQUATCH RESOURCES CORP. (CSE:SASQ) ("Sasquatch" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has entered into an option agreement...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The document is signed 'On Behalf of the Board of Directors Peter Smith Chief Executive Officer'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement is an option to 'conduct exploration on the Claims and to remove and process minerals', not to acquire a specific ownership percentage. No percentage interest is mentioned in the text.

primary_commodity.justification: The text states the historical production of the mine: 'The mine was in production from 1917 to 1919 and from 1956 to 1960, and produced copper, silver and gold.'

verified_article_link.justification: The article is about Sasquatch Resources Corp. entering an option agreement for the Blue Grouse Mine claims, which matches the project of interest. The link is provided at the end of the text.

currency.justification: The text mentions a '$25,000' payment. The acquiring company, Sasquatch Resources Corp., is listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE), which implies the currency is Canadian Dollars.

cash_payments_raw.justification: A conditional cash payment is part of the consideration: '...on commencement of commercial production on the Claims by Sasquatch, Sasquatch is required to make a cash payment of $25,000 to the Optionor...'

share_payments_raw.justification: The text does not mention any payments to be made in shares as part of the agreement.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: An explicit cash payment value is provided, so this combined field is not applicable according to the extraction hierarchy.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The agreement terms do not include the issuance of any shares.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The text does not mention any share warrant payments as part of the agreement.

option_payments_raw.justification: The text does not mention any option payments as part of the agreement.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction, so there is no associated share price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The exploration commitment is defined by the cost to keep claims in good standing, not a specific number of meters to be drilled.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The text requires 'such exploration expenditures on the Claims as are necessary to keep the Claims in good standing' but does not specify a minimum dollar amount for this commitment.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: As part of the consideration, Sasquatch is required to 'grant a 2% net smelter returns royalty to the Optionor.'

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text states the agreement is respecting 'three mineral claims (the "Claims") covering 191.34 hectares on Vancouver Island...'

coverage_area_unit.justification: The text states the agreement is respecting 'three mineral claims (the "Claims") covering 191.34 hectares on Vancouver Island...'

resource_size.justification: The text states that the 'Company plans to evaluate the waste-rock's composition, volume, and economic potential', which indicates a formal mineral resource has not yet been defined.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The press release identifies the acquiring company as 'SASQUATCH RESOURCES CORP. (CSE:SASQ)'.
